children: Future Vision II Acquisition entered into an unsecured promissory note for $65,000 with its sponsor to fund a deposit into the trust account and extend its business combination deadline from Oct 13, 2026 to Nov 13, 2026. The note bears no interest and matures upon the closing of the initial business combination; if no deal is completed, it will be forgiven. Upon closing, the sponsor may elect to convert the unpaid principal into units at $10.00 per unit.
: Unsecured non-interest-bearing promissory note; convertible at $10 per unit
: Fund one-month extension of SPAC deadline
